import sys,json
sys.path.insert(0,"tools")
import agent_config,mcp_client
config=agent_config.load("config/host.toml")
entry=next(x for x in config.mcp if x.name=="codex")
peer=mcp_client.MCPServer(entry.name,entry.command,entry.args,entry.env,entry.timeout_seconds)
try:
 tools={t.name:t for t in peer.start()}
 assert set(tools)=={"create_session","list_sessions","select_session","send","status","steer","interrupt","answer","updates","archive_session"},list(tools)
 text,error=peer.call(tools["list_sessions"],{"context_id":"preflight"})
 assert not error,text
 print(json.dumps({"server":peer.server_info,"tools":sorted(tools),"state":json.loads(text)},indent=2))
finally:peer.stop()
label: ssh-mcp-preflight
